prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity compositional variation for a desktop web application
Primary request: Create compositional option C for PPTExtract's human page-curation workbench. Use the supplied “样片审看室” reference only for its visual world: neutral monitor black, bright script/log paper, teal selection marks, amber pending marks, red exclusion marks, restrained hairlines, compact Chinese typography, and film-review transport grammar. Do not copy the reference topology.
Scene/backdrop: One continuous expert desktop application, straight-on and edge-to-edge, optimized for a curator processing many pages with keyboard shortcuts at 1440px.
Subject: A sanitized synthetic Chinese presentation page is the main evidence. Show a title, a bar/line chart, a table and exactly three numbered visual-object boundaries. All data is synthetic and unrelated to medicine or any real fixture.
Style/medium: High-fidelity Web UI mockup in the established sample-review-room world. Dense, precise, professional, implementable with semantic HTML/CSS.
Composition/framing: Landscape 3:2. Make this structurally different from both the reference and a horizontal logging desk: a “shot list + picture + log” vertical topology. Far left 14% is a compact vertical page/shot list with six page thumbnails, inherited/changed/pending markers, and direct page-number jump. Center 56% is the large standard page rendering on a matte dark monitor surround with three numbered object boundaries and crop handles. Right 30% is a full-height bright scene log: a compact page overview at top, then a vertically ordered visual-object shot list 01/02/03 with one expanded current object containing disposition, summary, 未确认草稿 and provenance, followed by the audit gate. No large bottom thumbnail filmstrip. The bottom is only a slim transport command rail; the top is a slim document/timecode/status bar.
Information requirements: visible 页面总述; visual object 01/02/03 ordered list; 纳入/排除 for each; summary; 未确认草稿; 继承预填; pending state; validation blocker; actions 批准, 排除, 重新打开; keyboard labels ←/→ 翻页, A 批准, X 排除, R 重新打开. Make selection, collapsed versus expanded objects, and inherited versus confirmed state obvious without relying on color alone.
Color palette: #171B20, #E8EBEC, #7CC8C5, #F2B84B, #E05D4D.
Materials/textures: matte neutral monitor surround, crisp script/log paper, subtle grease-pencil ticks. No decorative cinema imagery.
Text (verbatim where legible): "PPTExtract", "第 18 / 43 页", "页面", "页面总述", "视觉对象 01", "视觉对象 02", "视觉对象 03", "纳入", "排除", "summary", "未确认草稿", "继承预填", "PENDING 待审核", "批准", "重新打开", "A 批准", "X 排除", "← → 翻页".
Constraints: Chinese interface; sanitized synthetic content only; no real filenames, medical themes, people, logos, claims, or personal data. State cannot rely on color alone. Keep the evidence image color-neutral and dominant. Core controls must look buildable in HTML/CSS.
Avoid: copying the reference's large bottom thumbnail filmstrip, horizontal lower-third inspector, marketing hero, device mockup, surrounding room, people, gradients, glow, neon, glassmorphism, bento cards, oversized typography, excessive rounded corners, generic SaaS dashboard.
